geography_note: Morton is classified as exurban under the repository types because it is a lower-density, car-oriented small community with a 16.6-minute mean commute and relevant regional peers beyond 20 minutes. Census reports 1,336.4 people per square mile in 2020. The repository assigns exurban markets a 20-minute primary and 30-minute extended window. Tri-County at 20.94 minutes and Vision Care Center at 22.41 minutes fall in the extended context. This classification is directional because no catchment density surface or trip-tolerance study was completed.
route_provider: Nominatim/OpenStreetMap geocoding plus OSRM public point-to-point routing
route_method: Exact subject-origin to selected destination coordinate. Stored OSRM duration and route distance are used without converting older straight-line distances.
route_limitations: Routes are practice-origin point-to-point observations, not polygon isochrones or population-weighted patient choice.
OSRM public routes do not model live traffic or time-of-day variation.
Nominatim entity matches require review against official addresses.
The Walmart destination is the matched Supercenter entity, not a separately matched Vision Center entity.
Illinois Eye Center Washington had no Nominatim match and therefore no OSRM duration.
